newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics ships x2 modems, servers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics ships x2 modems, servers.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Tuesday it has begun shipping all MP 8/16 I-modems and NETServer 8/16 I-modem remote access servers with its x2 technology.

The products are for small- and medium-sized Internet Service Providers and corporations. The x2 technology allows for computer connecton speeds at up to 56 kilobits per second across conventional telephone lines.
All existing remote access servers and modem pools, or groups of modems, can be upgraded with software, which has been available from U.S. Robotics since March, the company said.
